text:
henry: Quick sync request — I'm drafting the console flow for automatic switchover/safeguard policies. Main ask: every request that gets 'switched' or 'quietly degraded' needs a clear, auditable trail (per-request link) we can jump to from the logs page. cc @anita @jihoon
anita: Love that. UX idea — small status pill on the request row: `served: primary` / `served: fallback` plus a chevron to open a compact audit panel. Panel shows why (trigger, error code), timeframe, and a link to full decision payload. Color should be neutral orange for degraded, red only for hard fail. :eyes:
jihoon: Technical note — full decision payload is ~1KB typical, but worst-case can be several KB. We should keep full JSON in our decision store and surface a sampled/preview JSON in the UI. Also we need a stable decision_id so operators and audits can reference the exact event.
jihoon: Example telemetry event we want emitted (rough draft):
```json
{
  "event_type": "switchover_decision",
  "decision_id": "dec_20260312001",
  "trigger": "model_timeout",
  "trigger_code": "TIMEOUT_2500ms",
  "original_route": "model:redwood-7b-v2",
  "chosen_route": "model:redwood-4b-quant",
  "confidence_score": "n/a",
  "sampled": false,
  "operator_override": null
}
```
emma: Important: billing/quotas question — if a request routes to a lower-capacity variant, do we bill the customer for the original model's token usage or the chosen route? product needs this spelled out + a toggle in the tenant config.
henry: Good catch. My proposal: bill based on served model variant (transparent), but keep a per-request charge_breakdown in the audit so we can recompute if needed.
oliver: For SRE/forensics — retention defaults: decision store 90 days, full payloads archived 365d if flagged for compliance. High-volume customers should get sampling controls (e.g., 1% full capture). We also need TTLs in the UI to avoid showing stale links.
jihoon: Operator/rollout control idea: immutable decision record + a small revision log. If an operator flips a route (manual override), we append an override event referencing original decision_id, don't mutate the original. CLI example to query decisions: `rictl decision get dec_20260312001 --json`
anita: UX edge cases — what do we show in chat/message UI when the output was degraded due to hallucination risk vs latency? My thought: explicit micro-copy: "Response reduced due to latency" vs "Response trimmed for safety". Different affordances (warning vs shield icon).
emma: Also add a tenant opt-in for verbose auditing (security/compliance pkg). Default is minimized to save space.
jihoon: Implementation note: we'll expose a compact audit payload in the API route that powers the console, and a download link for the full JSON. Keep perms tied to role: operator >= auditor can view full JSON; app-level keys only get compact payload.
deploy-bot: Deployed: switchover-audit-schema v1.2 by jihoon — service: decision-store, migration: add `decision_id` index.
henry: Thanks all. Action items: anita to mock compact panel + microcopy, jihoon to finalize telemetry schema and sampling knobs, emma/oliver to confirm retention + billing edgecases. I'll follow up with a short PRD by EOD. :thumbsup:
